outcome: Overweight/obesity in offspring at age 4-6 years
cohort: 407 participants in the 'SEguimiento del Niño para un Desarrollo Óptimo' Project
finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with an 8% absolute increase in the risk of overweight/obesity in offspring at age 4-6 years.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with an 8% absolute increase in the risk of overweight/obesity in offspring at age 4-6 years.
